# grothos (AI-Growth-OS)

> grothos is an AI-powered SEO, AEO, and GEO (AI-visibility) growth engine. Connect a site, scan issues, approve safe fixes, and deploy with verify/rollback.

## Preferred pages
- Homepage: https://grothos.vercel.app/
- Signup: https://grothos.vercel.app/signup
- Login: https://grothos.vercel.app/login

## Optional
